family: The single total threshold-two family defined in proof.md: for every n>=0, f_n(x)=1 exactly when x in {0,1}^n has at least two 1-bits (so f_0=f_1=0). One linear-time evaluator decides it at every length; the NP verifier accepts exactly the empty witness on accepted inputs, with witness bound zero.
theorem: For this one total uniform polynomial-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, C_B2(f_n)>=2n-3 at every integer length n=|x|>=2 in the full Li–Yang B2 model; hence C_B2(f_n)>=2n-o(n).
